translations.web: They stoop and they bow down together. They could not deliver the burden, but they have gone into captivity.
translations.bsb: The gods cower; they crouch together, unable to relieve the burden; but they themselves go into captivity.
translations.kjv: They stoop, they bow down together; they could not deliver the burden, but themselves are gone into captivity.
